venira.output_kind: running, exit_code, stdout_tail, stderr_tail. Unknown run_id gives not_found (run ids only live for this session).
venira.speed_profile: fast; not queued so it never blocks other tools.
venira.use_when: after a background project_shell_run: poll until running=false, then read exit_code.

description:
Return the state and output tail of a shell run. wait_seconds (0-30) waits up to that long for it to finish.
Use when: after a background project_shell_run: poll until running=false, then read exit_code.
Avoid when: you have no run_id yet.
Output: running, exit_code, stdout_tail, stderr_tail. Unknown run_id gives not_found (run ids only live for this session).

wait_seconds.description: Wait up to this many seconds for the run to finish (default 0, max 30). Observation window only, not a timeout.
